title: Cirrus SR22 G5 — Normal Operating Procedures
description: Normal operating procedures for the Cirrus SR22 G5 with Continental IO-550 engine, constant-speed propeller, and Perspective avionics (G1000-based). Covers preflight walk-around through shutdown and securing. All airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities, and performance figures must be obtained from the specific aircraft POH/AFM. The SR22 uses a sidestick and features the Cirrus Airframe Parachute System (CAPS); pilots must be trained on both. Not a substitute for factory-authorized training or recurrent proficiency.

source.notes: No manufacturer document consulted. Written from general familiarity with the type.

known_issues.description: Contains no airspeeds, power settings, fuel quantities or other limitations — must come from aircraft POH.
Equipment variations exist across SR22 G5 aircraft. Verify all items against the specific aircraft POH and avionics configuration before use.

rights.notes: Manufacturer POH and AFM remain under copyright. This file does not reproduce their wording or selection of items.
